properties.name: SOUNDNESS: a claim that holds only under an undischarged supposition cannot refute or defeat a claim outside that supposition's scope
properties.source: @ajs, 2026-10-18: "Capture the shortcomings (gaps) from the trial" and "see if there is anything else of note" in the AI branch he added
properties.statement:
A result derived under an assumption that no step discharges is "a result inside an argument, not a proof of it" (reflow2's own wording). It must not act as an established attacker against a claim outside that argument. At most it contests that claim conditionally, and the read-back names the supposition it depends on.
MEASURED by the observer on 2026-10-18, in the AI branch Anthony added to the cogito design (flo2.io 989598dd02246a81, 0.87.0):
- req:ai-is-res-cogitans-if reads `conditional`: "it holds only under the assumption(s) req:suppose-ai-authentically-doubts, which no step on the way to it discharges".
- Yet its CONTRADICTS edge makes req:ai-not-res-cogitans read REFUTED: "refuted by req:ai-is-res-cogitans-if, which holds".
- The edge's own evidence says the two are "kept as the open dispute this branch is about".
So a conditional result, used outside its assumption's scope, certifies a refutation. This is the same class as the generalization soundness hole N19, which phase 3 fixes: a check that ignores open assumptions.
